raw_selection.selection_policy: Minimum validation scaled 2-pinball across preserved original/rescue runs; original wins ties

rawknobs.ridge_objective: sum squared errors + lambda * squared standardized-feature coefficients; unpenalized intercept
rawknobs.preprocessing: Per-feature imputation and scaling fitted separately on each OOF past-fit subset; final fit uses all fit origins
rawknobs.oof: Five chronological blocks; first is warmup, next four use expanding past fit with H-label overlap purged
rawknobs.quantile_calibration: Separate channel-and-lead empirical quantiles of forward-only OOF residuals; no lead pooling
rawknobs.point_prediction: Direct ridge conditional-mean estimate; empirical quantile offsets create the distribution forecast
rawknobs.f0_raw_lag_residual: Not implemented; this run is RAW_VARX_RIDGE only
